questions.q: Recency has a Mann-Whitney p-value of 0.0098 but a Spearman correlation with churn of only 0.043. How should you read this?
options: The effect is large and important
The test is wrong
The effect is probably not zero but is small; with thousands of customers, tiny effects can be statistically significant
Recency should be the main feature
questions.explain: A p-value reflects sample size as well as effect size. A correlation of 0.043 is weak, so statistical significance here does not mean practical importance.

questions.q: Why are checks such as 'one row per customer' and '568 churners' written as code instead of remembered?
options: So that a later change to cleaning or labeling that breaks the pipeline is caught immediately
Because pandas requires assertions
To make the notebook longer
To replace the need for a test set
questions.explain: Automatic checks protect earlier work as the project evolves. A silent change to the population or label would otherwise flow into every later result.

questions.q: The segment of customers with tenure over one year and late share over 10% churns at 27.3% (874 customers). Why is it wrong to claim a firm profit from contacting them?
options: The segment is too small to count
The rule was chosen after looking at the labels (in-sample), exceeds the assumed capacity, and rests on assumed costs
Churn cannot be priced
The break-even precision is above 27.3%
questions.explain: The rule was found by inspecting the outcome, so the true rate is likely lower; the list is far larger than the illustrative capacity; and the costs are assumptions. It supports continuing, not a profit claim.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the 'Not known' section of the checkpoint memo?
options: To hide weaknesses from the stakeholder
To list features that were dropped
To record the code version
To separate what the evidence shows from open questions, such as whether signals predict well or whether tenure is a cause or a proxy
questions.explain: Stating uncertainties openly builds trust and tells the team what modeling and later analysis still need to answer.

questions.q: 5,757 orders are dated after the cancellation date of customers who cancelled before the snapshot. What is the right handling?
options: Add those orders as features
Delete the cancellations table
Note that these customers are out of scope, so the model is unaffected, and report the quirk to the data owner
Change the snapshot date
questions.explain: The population filter already excludes these customers, so the quirk does not touch the model. Logging it and raising it with the source-system owner is what a careful data scientist does.
